description: The pending-type contract of Phase 2 (spec §B.1, §D.7): which TypeScript files and type names mirror the build-out schema, and the objects each must declare. scripts/db/check-pending-contract.mjs reads this map with a TypeScript Program + TypeChecker ('@/' -> src/) and compares it with the harness export of scripts/db/schema-export.mjs. Lane 1 owns this file; the TS files belong to Lane 2 and are never edited by the checker.

tables.notification_outbox: service role only: the browser never reads it (spec §A.15, §B.1)

columns.admin_action_log.company_id: server-side only: the service role and definers write the admin action log and no browser code reads it (20261123010400)

functions.export_module_key: pure helper of the export engine (a source key's module); no browser caller
functions.format_reference_text: pure formatter; the client has its TS original (src/lib/records/reference.ts)
functions.format_voyage_reference_text: pure formatter; the client has its TS original (src/lib/records/reference.ts)
functions.module_enabled: server-side check for Phase 3 calendars, notifications and reports; the client resolves module settings itself (spec §A.5, D-63)
functions.normalise_code_text: pure helper of the vessel-code derivation (D-03); the client has its TS original
functions.vessel_code_candidates: pure helper of the vessel-code derivation (D-03); the client has its TS original
functions.vessel_code_letters: pure helper of the vessel-code derivation (D-03); the client has its TS original
functions.vessel_code_stored: pure helper of the vessel-code derivation (D-03); the client has its TS original
functions.vessel_codes_assign: pure helper of the vessel-code derivation (D-03); the client has its TS original
functions.vessel_in_reachable_state: pure helper of the reach rules; the client has its TS original (membershipReach.ts)
functions.permission_override_write_allowed: RLS predicate (rule 11): policies call it, the browser does not
functions.rbac_user_roles_write_allowed: RLS predicate (rule 11): policies call it, the browser does not
functions.has_role_in_company: RLS predicate (rule 11) of the company-scoped legacy role policies (20261123010500): policies call it, the browser does not
functions.vessel_company_of: RLS helper (rule 11) of the company-scoped legacy role policies (20261123010500): resolves a vessel's company without the caller's RLS, and answers only a caller of that company (or a superadmin there; NULL for anyone else, a disabled caller included); policies call it, the browser does not
functions.profile_company_of: RLS helper (rule 11, rule 15) of the company-scoped legacy role policies (20261123010500): pins a crew + vessel row to the crew member's company, and answers only a caller of that company (or a superadmin there; NULL for anyone else, a disabled caller included); policies call it, the browser does not
functions.admin_may_view_user: RLS predicate (rule 11) of the admin read policies on memberships, user_roles, rbac_user_roles, overrides and invitations (20261123000400, 010100, 010200): policies call it, the browser does not
functions.user_company_for_admin: RLS predicate of rbac_user_roles (spec §A.4, §A.8): policies call it
functions.record_readable: RLS predicate of every record table (spec §A.10): policies call it
functions.storage_path_allowed: RLS predicate of the records bucket (spec §A.13): storage policies call it
functions.record_digest_of: pure helper of the record engine (parity with the TS engines)
functions.record_js_trim: pure helper of the record engine (parity with the TS engines)
functions.record_json_truthy: pure helper of the record engine (parity with the TS engines)
functions.record_normalise_office: pure helper of the record engine (parity with the TS engines)
functions.record_refusal: pure helper of the record engine (builds a refusal result)
functions.record_slot_template_valid: pure helper backing the record_kinds slot-template CHECK
functions.record_text_blank: pure helper of the record engine (parity with the TS engines)
functions.record_vessel_signatures_locked: pure mirror of vesselSignaturesLocked() (D-51); the client has its TS original
